column2:
In the beginning, only elves were
able to weave mana.
<pause>
It was a skill that should have
belonged only to elves.
<pause>
When those with diluted elven blood
appeared--half-elves, as they came
to be known--the world began its
descent into chaos.
<pause>
Magic is intended to be a tool used
to sustain daily life.
<pause>
However, the half-elves began using
it not only for that, but to commit
murder.
<pause>
Certainly, magic has the power to
even make a star fall upon the
world.
<pause>
However, long ago, our elven
ancestors sealed away many of the
most powerful spells.
<pause>
I pray such spells will never be
necessary in this world.{END}

morning.
<pause>
The men head into the woods to
hunt, while the women tend to
vegetable gardens after finishing

reading.

prepared.

As the sun sets, the elves thank God
for another peaceful day, and turn
in for sleep.{END}
